facts.statement: Leakage uses information not available at prediction time when building a model and can make held-out performance estimates overly optimistic.
Audit which rows and fields reach fit operations and each prediction, then remove held-out or future information from those operations.
Separate training and evaluation before fitting preprocessing, and call transform rather than fit or fit_transform on held-out inputs.
Write assert predicate checks for the declared valid, boundary and failure cases; a false predicate raises AssertionError during ordinary non-optimized execution.

practice.objective: Audit the supplied order workflow against its acceptance-time prediction contract. In a learner-defined Python function with learner-written imports, exclude the eventual-arrival field from prediction inputs and ensure preprocessing fits only the designated training rows. Write assert checks using the supplied valid, boundary and failure fixtures.
practice.success: The learner localizes each information-boundary defect. The same assertions fail on the leaked workflow and pass after correction, establishing that prediction inputs contain only decision-available fields, preprocessing fits only training rows, and held-out inputs receive transform without refitting.

live_code.required_skill: Trace row and field access through supplied workflow scaffolding, correct preprocessing and prediction-input boundaries, and verify those boundaries with assert predicates.
allowed_syntax: import statements for the required fixture and preprocessing dependencies
calls to supplied fixture and workflow interfaces
array or table indexing and column selection
blocked_syntax: new estimator construction or learner-authored estimator training
live_code.starter_state_intent: Provide the order-at-acceptance fixture, designated training and held-out rows, an eventual-arrival field, existing preprocessing and prediction scaffolding, and observable fit/input traces. Supply valid, boundary and failure fixtures, but leave the correction function, its imports and its assertions for the learner to author.
live_code.observable_success: Fixture traces show only designated training rows reaching preprocessing fit, no eventual-arrival field reaching prediction inputs, and transform-only handling of held-out inputs. Learner-written assertions pass for the corrected valid and boundary cases and raise AssertionError for the leaked failure cases during ordinary non-optimized execution.
